frozen_EXT04_meaning.roadmap_line: EXT-03: AS-08, AS-27 (baseline reproducibility) / EXT-04: AS-01, AS-02, AS-03, AS-04, AS-05, AS-07 (optional)

why_it_matters: ROADMAP_INTEGRITY: a reader tracing EXT-03 -> EXT-04 -> EXT-05 finds a progression slot occupied by a benchmark study
AUTHORIZATION_LAUNDERING: a new study inherits credibility from an already-frozen identifier
PREREGISTRATION_SEMANTICS: AS-01..05 and AS-07 are preregistered; reusing their container blurs preregistered vs post-hoc
PROVENANCE: a future audit asking 'what was EXT-04?' would find two incompatible answers in one repository

rationale: Correct parent: the study repairs AS-08, an EXT-03 assignment
